title: Winter traction concerns
summary: This topic centers on complaints about poor traction in winter or snowy conditions, with one unrelated mention of difficulty using technology features reducing cluster coherence.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor traction, especially in winter or on snowy inclines, including dissatisfaction versus prior vehicles and attempts to address the issue with snow tires.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention traction struggles on a snowy mountain incline and, separately, difficulty with advanced technology features without enough detail to confirm the same issue theme.

limitations: The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to describe broader patterns beyond the quoted comments.
The cluster includes at least one unrelated fragment about advanced technology features rather than traction or winter driving.
Several negative fragments come from the same reviews, so the examples are not fully independent.
